mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting ADH to the collecting ducts was most worthwhile: it showed how a signal changes kidney water recovery and leaves less water in urine.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the brain-to-blood route to the body felt repetitive because the preceding construction had already shown nerve endings releasing ADH into blood vessels.

surprise.text: The separate construction of the pituitary nerve endings and blood vessels clarified how a signal from the brain reaches the blood.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and goal gave each combination a plausible purpose.

continue.text: I would be mildly interested in another chapter if it introduced a new relationship between systems. This chapter's signal-to-kidney sequence was clear, though assembling the route afterward felt repetitive.
